verdict: Paid ads have not launched; Google Business Profile is your only active channel.
narrative: This period, all engagement came from your Google Business Profile — paid search and Meta ads have not spent a single dollar or generated a single lead, because five launch milestones due July 31 and August 1 remain incomplete. GBP delivered 81 total actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) over the 28 days, but activity dropped 57% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days prior, a trend we are watching closely. Completing the overdue launch steps — verification, landing pages, and ad activation — is the immediate priority so paid channels can begin driving leads. Once ads are live, you should expect spend, clicks, and inbound leads to appear in this report for the first time.

watch_item.issue: Five launch milestones — pre-launch stack test, LSA verification, site and landing pages, Google Ads go-live, and Meta retargeting — are all overdue, leaving paid channels completely inactive.
watch_item.fix: These milestones are being resolved now so ads can launch and begin generating leads.
